title: Storage Addendum Conditions — Reservation Hold and Move-In
content:
A Storage Rental begins with a reservation and becomes active at move-in. Figures that vary by product (the reservation fee, the hold period, whether the fee is credited, whether a condition check is signed, whether Larkspur supplies the lock and its charge, and the contents insurance minimum) are those of the product reserved.

## 1. Reservation

1.1 A reservation holds the unit for the product's reservation hold period, counted in calendar days after the reserved date, and posts the product's reservation fee.

1.2 A reservation not moved into by the end of the hold period lapses and is cancelled, and the reservation fee is not refunded.

1.3 The resident may cancel a reservation before move-in to the unit.

## 2. Move-in

2.1 At move-in the resident signs the storage addendum and receives access to the unit; the rental becomes active. Where the product has a signed move-in condition check, the resident also signs a move-in condition check of the unit.

2.2 The first month posts on the first rented day, prorated by the days rented in that month.

2.3 Where the product's reservation fee is credited, the reservation fee is credited against the first month's rent at move-in.

2.4 Where Larkspur supplies the lock for the product, Larkspur fits a lock, billing the product's lock charge when that charge is not $0.00. Otherwise the resident supplies a disc lock.

2.5 Where the product requires contents insurance, the contents must be insured for at least the product's minimum personal property coverage.

## Hold period at the boundary (hypothetical reservation, product with a 7-day hold)

| Move-in falls on | Within the hold? | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| The 7th calendar day after the reserved date | Yes | Move-in proceeds under clause 2 |
| The 8th calendar day after the reserved date, with no move-in before | No | The reservation has lapsed and is cancelled; the reservation fee is not refunded |

The count starts on the calendar day after the reserved date; the reserved date itself is day 0.

## Clause 2 applied (hypothetical)

A Standard Storage Unit (5x5) — reservation fee $25.00, fee credited, condition check signed, lock not supplied by Larkspur, contents coverage required — is reserved and moved into on the 6th of a 30-day month at a monthly rent of $55.00.

- The resident signs the storage addendum and the move-in condition check.
- The first month posts for 25 rented days (the 6th through the 30th): $55.00 multiplied by 25 and divided by 30, rounded to the cent, is **$45.83**.
- The $25.00 reservation fee is credited against that first month.
- The resident supplies a disc lock.
- The contents must be insured for at least $5000.

## Points of judgement

- **Lapse.** A reservation that has not been moved into by the end of the hold period lapses; the fee is kept.
- **Condition check.** Signed at move-in only for products that have one; the Bike Storage Locker has none.
- **Lock charge.** A charge is billed for a Larkspur-fitted lock only when the product's lock charge is not $0.00.
